title: Personalized Basketball on Court Perspective Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Transform any bedroom into an exciting sports haven with this personalized basketball comforter from Jeminise. Featuring a dynamic sports design, this bedding is perfect for basketball players, fans, and kids who love the game. Customization options allow you to easily add your own name and number for a truly unique and thoughtful gift.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Custom options let you personalize the bedding set with your own Name and Number.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Made from soft, comfy, and lightweight 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features tight, smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges with environmental protection dyeing techniques to prevent fading.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water. Dries quickly on low or no heat and fluffs up beautifully after washing.
  • Versatile Components: Complete your bedding setup with options for matching pillowcases and a flat sheet cover.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Basketball D4
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Compact
Theme Art, Number, Personalized
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Closure Type Zipper
